data.title: Musterbank: account fee rising to €6.90, your consent required
data.summary: Musterbank eG wants to raise the monthly fee for your Girokonto Klassik from €4.90 to €6.90 from 1 December 2026. It needs your explicit consent, requested by 30 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your bank wants to raise the monthly account fee (Kontoführungspreis) by €2. Silence does not count as agreement, so you must actively decide. You can consent in online banking or by returning the signed reply form by 30 November 2026. If you don't consent, the bank says it may terminate the account with two months' notice. You can also cancel your account free of charge at any time. The bank mentions a free "Start" account for people in education up to age 27, which may suit a student. Compare options before deciding.
